title: Recursive Function Definitions
description: Define square as a lambda, define pow recursively, then compose them to compute (pow 5 3)^2.

steps.description: Reveal square: a lambda that multiplies n by itself.
Reveal pow: recursive lambda with base case k=0 returns 1, otherwise n * (pow n (- k 1)).
Reveal composition: (square (pow 5 3)) squares the result of 5 to the power of 3.
Run to show 15625 as the final result.
